eventDetail.scope: The International Workshop on Rapid System Prototyping (RSP) emphasizes design experience sharing and a collaborative approach between hardware and software research communities from industry and academia. It considers prototyping as an iterative design methodology for embedded hardware and software systems. The RSP series of workshops aims at bridging the gaps in embedded system design between applications, architectures, tools, and technologies to achieve rapid system prototyping of emerging software and hardware systems.
